```python
from pytrends.request import TrendReq
import pandas as pd

keywords = ['VGT', 'MGK', 'VONG']

start_period = interest_df.iloc[:30].mean()
end_period = interest_df.iloc[-30:].mean()
summary = pd.DataFrame({
    'ETF': keywords,
    'Start (2013 proxy)': [round(start_period[k], 2) for k in keywords],
    'End (2023 proxy)': [round(end_period[k], 2) for k in keywords]
})
summary['Pct Increase Proxy (%)'] = ((summary['End (2023 proxy)'] - summary['Start (2013 proxy)']) / summary['Start (2013 proxy)']) * 100
print(summary)
print("\nWinner (by proxy):", summary.loc[summary['Pct Increase Proxy (%)'].idxmax(), 'ETF'])
```
